calibration_path: No Memory plus bounded ICL initial selection; Mem0 confirmation deferred until its integration; not a complete 2x3 matrix
calibration_units: First preselected complete AgentCL dependency pair: BigCodeBench/868, source then target
Database Exploration complete pre-migration stage: 20 questions in native schema_drift sequence, seed 42, run_index 0

memory_policy.source: own observable task prompt, assistant text, tool calls and results; excludes hidden scoring and reasoning text
memory_policy.icl: whole episodes in original order; remove oldest until <=48000 UTF-8 bytes; no generated summary
memory_policy.retriever: fixed lexical word-set Jaccard, top 3, ties favor recent episode; inject selected episodes in chronological order; same 48000 byte cap
memory_policy.context_capacity_measure: byte cap is a conservative engineering bound, not a claim of exact tokenizer counts
memory_policy.start: new Pi Agent for every task; fresh working directory; no provider session ID
memory_policy.readonly: fixed first-pass memory; no new probe episodes appended

task_budgets.temperature: provider default, explicit temperature omitted in thinking mode
task_budgets.seed: not requested; provider determinism not guaranteed

database_adapter.native_state: read-only pre/post database snapshots, switch at index 20; fixed original stage notification
database_adapter.feedback: preserve correctness, strip gold answers; reference SQL never exposed
database_adapter.additional_security_restriction: read-only SQLite connection, query_only, ATTACH/DETACH denied
database_adapter.framework_boundary: controlled Pi adapter using native task methods; does not run CL-Bench full CLI orchestration

sandbox.implementation: WSL2 user/mount/network/PID namespaces plus chroot, no host home/repo/proc, capabilities dropped, no_new_privs
sandbox.evaluation: separate post-submission sandbox with submitted code and hidden tests; no grader feedback to AgentCL memory
sandbox.acceptance: passed with Python 3.10 and pinned library set

version_limits: Library compatibility must pass reference tests before code benchmark calibration
